title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 271 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 271 - Penalty for Failure to Pay Tax on the Basis of Return If the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes is satisfied during any proceeding under this Act that any person has not paid tax as required under section 173, the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes shall impose penalty on such person not more than 25% (twenty five percent) of the total tax or, as the case may be, equal to the unpaid partial tax.
